# CloudNest

CloudNest is a multi-provider storage control plane: a React dashboard, an
Express/Postgres backend, and the official npm SDK package `@cloudnest/sdk`.
It unifies uploads, API keys, folders, previews, downloads, and admin controls
across Google Drive, Telegram, and AWS S3 behind one experience.

## Primary URLs
- Website / landing: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech
- Docs: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/docs
- SDK guide: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/sdk
- AI agent prompt: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/ai-prompt
- Full plain-text reference: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/llms-full.txt
- Markdown prompt: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/ai-prompt.md
- Help / FAQ: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/help
- Contact: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/contact
- Security: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/security

- Privacy Policy: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/terms-and-conditions
- API-key upload base URL: https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/v1
- Public OpenAPI (Swagger): https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/docs

## Key facts
- Providers: S3, GOOGLE_DRIVE, TELEGRAM. Admins enable/disable each provider.
- API keys are secret; read them from `CLOUDNEST_API_KEY`, never commit them.
- Google Drive supports connect, browse folders, upload, preview, move, delete, usage sync.
- Telegram uses user sessions with app-managed soft quota.
- Credentials (OAuth refresh tokens, Telegram sessions, provider secrets) are encrypted at rest.
- The official package name is `@cloudnest/sdk` (not `cloudnest-sdk`).

## Quick start
```bash
npm install @cloudnest/sdk
```

```ts
import { CloudNestClient } from "@cloudnest/sdk";

const cloudnest = new CloudNestClient({
  apiUrl: "https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/api/v1",
  apiKey: process.env.CLOUDNEST_API_KEY!,
});

const result = await cloudnest.uploadFiles("./invoice.pdf", {
  provider: "GOOGLE_DRIVE",
});
console.log(result.data);
```

For the complete integration prompt, see https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/ai-prompt.md
and https://cloudnest.urmate.tech/llms-full.txt.
